_meta.name: who_target_list_adult
_meta.description: Example cause schema: the Level-2 cause categories of the WHO 2022 target list for verbal autopsy, adult deaths, with each category's WHO VA codes and ICD-10 scope. Site-neutral: population_context is empty. Copy it and keep only the causes your data uses, or use it as the reference for the analysis_va_codes of your own schema.

Cardiac disease.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Acute cardiac disease; Sickle cell with crisis; Other and unspecified cardiac dis.

Chronic pulmonary disease and asthma.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Chronic obstructive pulmonary dis; Asthma.

Diabetes.scope_note: the WHO VA category Diabetes mellitus.

Diarrhea.scope_note: the WHO VA category Diarrhoeal diseases.

HIV/AIDS.scope_note: the WHO VA category HIV/AIDS related death.

Indeterminate.scope_note: the WHO VA category Cause of death unknown.

Liver cirrhosis.scope_note: the WHO VA category Liver cirrhosis.

Malnutrition and anaemia.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Severe anaemia; Severe malnutrition.

Maternal conditions.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Ectopic pregnancy; Abortion-related death; Pregnancy-induced hypertension; Obstetric haemorrhage; Obstructed labour; Pregnancy-related sepsis; Anaemia of pregnancy; Ruptured uterus; Other and unspecified maternal CoD.

Meningitis and encephalitis.scope_note: the WHO VA category Meningitis and encephalitis.

Neoplasms.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Oral neoplasms; Digestive neoplasms; Respiratory neoplasms; Breast neoplasms; Reproductive neoplasms M, F; Other and unspecified neoplasms; Digestive neoplasms Oesophageal cancer; Respiratory neoplasms Throat cancer; Female reproductive neoplasms; Male reproductive neoplasms.

Other and unspecified external causes.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Accid fall; Accid drowning and submersion; Accid expos to smoke, fire \; Contact with venomous plant/animal; Accid poisoning and noxious subs; Exposure to force of nature; Other and unspecified external CoD.

Other and unspecified infections.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Sepsis (non-obstetric); Measles; Meningitis and encephalitis; Tetanus; Pertussis; Haemorrhagic fever; Other and unspecified infect dis; Sepsis; Neonatal tetanus; Unspecified infectious disease.

Other and unspecified non communicable d.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Severe anaemia; Severe malnutrition; Acute abdomen; Renal failure; Epilepsy; Other and unspecified NCD; Prematurity; Birth asphyxia; Neonatal pneumonia; Neonatal sepsis; Congenital malformation; Other and unspecified neonatal CoD; Fresh stillbirth; Macerated stillbirth.

Pneumonia.scope_note: the WHO VA category Acute resp infect, incl pneumonia.

Pulmonary tuberculosis.scope_note: the WHO VA category Pulmonary tuberculosis.

Suicide.scope_note: the WHO VA category Intentional self-harm.

Traffic / transport accident.scope_note: the WHO VA categories Road traffic accident; Other transport accident.
